description: Default-off generic allocentric world-view memory using a persistent grow/update/decay pattern without any game mode, host grid, geometry-class, or occupancy assumptions. A mechanical ingress token may point only to already graph-admitted current-epoch OpticRangeEvidence. Graph rules associate that evidence with persistent AllocentricWorldViewCell nodes by uncertainty-supported nearest-neighbour selection using ArgminUnique, refusing exact distance ties. Novel support mints a cell; revisits update evidence count, confidence, uncertainty, and freshness; unobserved cells decay and become stale without deletion. A cell publishes explicit epoch-scoped surface_value photometry only from exactly one admissible source: current HeldPredictionResidual photometry on its own unique optic evidence is primary, while a unique current transsaccadic VisualTile is the longer-lived fallback. Constant-key ArgminUnique gates both routes, so zero or ambiguous sources never acquire an iteration-order value and stale publications are explicitly nulled/refused. The faculty represents uncertain visible-surface support, never committed occupancy, free space, walls, or task policy.

rules.name: world_view_mint_novel_surface_support
rules.comment: Novel means no stored cell's own uncertainty support overlaps the evidence. No host bin size, occupancy threshold, or world-specific grid is introduced.

rules.name: world_view_update_unique_supported_cell
rules.comment: Association is the unique nearest cell among uncertainty-overlapping candidates. ArgminUnique refuses an exact distance tie; Python never bins, ranks, or selects.

rules.name: world_view_publish_unique_current_held_surface_value
rules.comment: Fresh photometry attached directly to this cell's own optic evidence is primary. Constant-key ArgminUnique gates both hops: exactly one current grounded evidence carrying photometry and exactly one current HeldPredictionResidual on it. Ambiguity at either hop publishes nothing.

rules.name: world_view_publish_unique_current_surface_value
rules.comment: A constant-key ArgminUnique is an exact-one gate: one admissible current spatially-enriching VisualTile returns that tile; zero returns null; two or more tie exactly and return null. The graph therefore publishes photometry without iteration-order choice.

rules.name: world_view_refuse_nonunique_or_stale_surface_value
rules.comment: There is no unset-attribute effect. A cell that has never had exactly one current tile keeps surface_value absent. A previously published value is explicitly nulled and refused when its epoch passes or the current admissible set is no longer exactly one.
